checks.cmd: ! git grep -nE '= test_[a-z_]+\.[A-Z][A-Za-z]+\.[a-z_]+' -- tests && ! git grep -n '\.plane-runtime' -- 'tests/test_*.py' ':(exclude)tests/test_plane_json_constants.py' && python3 -B scripts/house_checks.py e4-count --max 448 && python3 -B scripts/house_checks.py e4-imports && ! git grep -nF '__file__).resolve().parent' -- 'tests/*.py' ':(exclude)tests/helpers.py' && ! git grep -nw GIT_AUTHOR_NAME -- 'tests/*.py' ':(exclude)tests/helpers.py' && ! git grep -nP '^\s*[A-Z_]+ = PLANE_ROOT\s*(#.*)?$' -- 'tests/*.py' && ! git grep -nwP 'PLANE_ROOT as' -- 'tests/*.py'
! git grep -n -e merge-tree -e patch-id -e remerge-diff -- ccp ':(exclude)ccp/gitmerge.py'
! git grep -nE '_BINDING_LINE|def read_binding' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/lib.py' && ! git grep -nP 'bindings_dir\(\) / f["\x27]\{' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/lib.py'
! git grep -nE 'CCP_GH_BIN|headRefOid|mergeCommit' -- ccp ':(exclude)ccp/prhost.py' && ! git grep -n 'gh pr' -- templates plugin/agents && ! git grep -n 'refs/pull' -- ccp ':(exclude)ccp/prhost.py'

! git grep -n CHECK_RE -- ccp ':(exclude)ccp/tasklog.py' && ! git grep -nE 'search\(rf"\^## |tasklog\._section' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/tasklog.py' && ! git grep -nE 're\.search\(r?f?"\^(#\{\{?1,|\(#\+\))' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/mdsection.py'
! git grep -nE '\\d[+{][^"]*-\[a-z0-9\]' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/refs.py' && ! git grep -nF 'rf"^Task ' -- ccp scripts ':(exclude)ccp/refs.py'

! awk 'length > 300 {print FILENAME ": " substr($0, 1, 60); n++} END {exit n == 0}' docs/cli/*.md && ! git grep -nP '^\s*(\x60{3}|~{3})' -- docs/cli && ! git grep -niP '\bexits? (code )?[0-9]|\bexit code' -- docs/cli

probes.cmd: claude auth status 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.exit(0 if json.load(sys.stdin).get("loggedIn") else 1)'
